name: Leaders-In-Training (LIT) and Counselors-In-Training (CIT), YMCA Camp Jones Gulch
city: La Honda, CA (YMCA Camp Jones Gulch, 11000 Pescadero Road)
what_you_do: LITs (ages 14 to 15) do camp activities plus leadership training, ropes courses and a legacy project. CITs (age 16) stay two weeks: first they train, then they help lead a cabin of younger campers.
who_can_apply: LIT: for 14 and 15 year olds. CIT: for 16 year olds. No city or residency rule is stated. The page does not say whether a CIT must have done LIT first.
pay_detail: Each session needs a $150 non-refundable deposit at registration. The full price is shown only in the online registration system, not on the page. Financial assistance is available.
duration: LIT: one 6-day, 5-night session (Sunday to Friday). CIT: two weeks.
deadline_text: Summer 2026: LIT sessions ran weekly from June 14 to Aug 7, 2026. CIT Session A ran June 28 to July 10 and Session B ran July 19 to 31, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Register online through the YMCA of Greater San Francisco registration site (the Register button on the overnight camps page) and pay the $150 deposit per session. Camp office: (650) 747-1200, Monday to Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
notes: This is a teen camp you pay for, not a job. To ask for aid, email the YMCA form with two kinds of proof of income. The page says replies take about 15 business days. Families can ask for up to 4 cabin mates who are within 2 years of age. Deposits are not paid back.
